welcome.title: Welcome to the AlertPort platform
welcome.content: Hello! I'll walk you through the essentials of setting up your operation in just a few minutes. You can skip anytime. The tour is always available from your profile menu in the top-right corner.

dashboard.title: Dashboard: your overview
dashboard.content: These cards show, in real time, the day's total alerts, pending, answered and missed. It's the first thing you see when you log in.

clientsMenu.title: 1. Start with Clients
clientsMenu.content: The first step is registering your Clients: the companies or residential complexes you serve. Everything (sites, patrols, reports) is organized around them. I'll take you to that screen now.

clientsCreate.title: Register a Client
clientsCreate.content: Click this button to create your first Client. You'll enter name, tax ID and contact details. Next we move on to that Client's Sites.

sitesMenu.title: 2. Register the Sites
sitesMenu.content: For each Client you register the Sites (physical locations where your Guards work). Without a Site you can't schedule patrols or link devices.

sitesCreate.title: Create a Site
sitesCreate.content: This is the button to register a Site. Once saved, the Site generates a unique QR Code, used to link the Guard's device.

qrcode.title: 3. Site QR Code + AlertPort app
qrcode.content: Each Site generates a unique QR Code. In the AlertPort app installed on the Guard's phone, they scan the QR Code and the device becomes linked to that Site. Only after this scan does the device show up as available in Schedules.

equipmentMenu.title: 4. Linked equipment
equipmentMenu.content: Here you see every device linked to your Sites. Each row shows which Site has which device and its status (online, inactive, blocked).

equipmentCreate.title: New equipment
equipmentCreate.content: If you ever need to register a device manually before scanning the QR Code (rare scenarios), use this button. The recommended flow is still to scan the QR Code with the app.

collaborators.title: 5. Collaborators (Guards)
collaborators.content: Register your Guards here. They're the ones who receive alerts on the AlertPort app, clock in and respond to events. Set their shift and the Sites where each one works.

users.title: 6. Central operators
users.content: Operators monitor the system 24/7, handle SOS and make calls. Register them here with OPERATOR role. Admins are also managed from this screen.

schedulingMenu.title: 7. Alert scheduling
schedulingMenu.content: With Client + Site + linked device in place, you create alert schedules. The Guard receives them on the app and must press to confirm they're active at the Site. It's the classic "don't fall asleep on the job".

schedulingCalendar.title: Scheduling calendar
schedulingCalendar.content: This is the calendar where you create and view schedules. Drag to create a new one, click to edit. Daily, weekly or monthly recurrence.

monitor.title: 8. Alert Monitor
monitor.content: This is the screen your operator keeps open throughout the shift. Real-time SOS, scheduled events and time entries appear here. It supports phone calls and silent listening.

attendance.title: 9. Attendance Control
attendance.content: Guard time entries (clock-in, clock-out, breaks) appear here. Useful for shift tracking and labor compliance.

recordings.title: 10. Call recordings
recordings.content: Every call made through the platform is recorded and kept here. Useful for auditing, contractual proof and training.

reports.title: 11. Reports
reports.content: Four key reports: Patrol Adherence (the main one, proof that the Guard responded), Attendance SLA, SOS Alerts and Attendance Control. Exportable as XLSX, CSV and PDF.

plan.title: 12. Your Plan
plan.content: Track your plan, trial period and limits here. When you're ready to subscribe or upgrade, this is the place.

finish.title: All set!
finish.content: You know the essentials. Remember the path: Clients, then Sites, then QR Code in the app, then link devices, then create schedules. You can replay this tour anytime from the profile menu.

welcome.title: Welcome, operator
welcome.content: Your shift has started. I'll show you where everything lives and how to respond to alerts. You can skip and replay later from your profile menu.

kpis.title: Today's indicators (KPIs)
kpis.content: At the top of the Monitor: total events, SOS of the day, Available (not attended yet), In progress and Time Entries. The "Available" card is what you need to attend to.

eventCard.title: Event cards
eventCard.content: Each alert becomes a card with time, Site, Guard and priority. The "Open attendance" button starts the attendance. Once attended, the card moves to the "In progress by you" section.

sosGlobal.title: SOS reaches any screen
sosGlobal.content: Regardless of which page you're on, an SOS triggers an audible alarm and shows a red banner at the top. Click "Attend now" to jump straight to the alert.

attendanceOwner.title: Exclusive attendance: one operator per event
attendanceOwner.content: When you open an attendance, the event gets locked to you. No other operator can attend the same one. This prevents two operators from handling the same SOS simultaneously.

callActions.title: Normal call and silent listen
callActions.content: During attendance you can make a normal call (conversation) or silent listen (you listen without the Guard knowing, useful in emergencies).

recording.title: Call recording
recording.content: While on a call, press the record button. You have up to 3 minutes; after that the recording is saved automatically and you can start a new one.

recordingsHistory.title: Recording history
recordingsHistory.content: Every recorded call lives here. You can filter by Client, Site, date and play them again. Useful for reports and audits.

occurrences.title: Event history
occurrences.content: Full list of every event (SOS, incidents) in the operation. Search by date, Site or Guard.

timeEntries.title: Time Entries
timeEntries.content: Guards clock in from the app. Here you check the clock-in, clock-out and breaks of each collaborator during the shift.

reports.title: Your reports
reports.content: You have access to the SOS Alerts and Attendance reports. Exportable as XLSX, CSV and PDF to share with clients.

finish.title: Ready for your shift
finish.content: You now know the full flow. Tip: keep the Monitor open at all times, attend SOS quickly and record calls when needed. Have a good shift!

export.title: Export my data
export.description: Download a JSON snapshot of everything we hold on you.
export.note: The download is generated in your browser; nothing is stored server-side.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.description: This is irreversible and anonymizes your personal data.
delete.confirmDescription: On confirm, your personal data is anonymized and your account archived. Audit records and legal obligations are preserved per applicable law.
delete.bullet1: Email, name, phone, and address are replaced with placeholders.
delete.bullet2: Your credentials are invalidated and you will be logged out.
delete.bullet3: Attendance records and compliance history are kept for legal purposes.
delete.toastSuccess: Your account has been anonymized. Goodbye.
